title: Yukawa scalar self energy at two loop and $\langle φ^2 \rangle$ in the inflationary de Sitter spacetime
summary: We have considered the Yukawa theory at two loop in the inflationary de Sitter spacetime, for a massless minimally coupled scalar and a massless fermion. The one loop computation for the same has been investigated in detail in the earlier literatures. The chief motivation behind this study is the fact that at one loop, the scalar self energy contains only fermions, which are conformally invariant.
